question: The school information management system shall record and manage common operations for administrators, teachers, and regular users respectively. The system shall store basic information of users with different identities, and allow administrators or teachers to maintain dormitories, courses, and grades. It shall also enable regular users to view their own grades and submit dormitory repair requests.
ddl:
-- Schema for database: rschema_0428

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `dormitories` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `capacity` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `location` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `courses` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `credits` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `grades` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `course_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `grade` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `course_id` (`course_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `grades_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `grades_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`course_id`) REFERENCES `courses` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `dormitory_repair_requests` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `dormitory_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `dormitory_id` (`dormitory_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `dormitory_repair_requests_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `dormitory_repair_requests_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`dormitory_id`) REFERENCES `dormitories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_dormitory_assignments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `dormitory_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `dormitory_id` (`dormitory_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_dormitory_assignments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_dormitory_assignments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`dormitory_id`) REFERENCES `dormitories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `course_enrollments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `course_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `course_id` (`course_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `course_enrollments_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `course_enrollments_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`course_id`) REFERENCES `courses` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `dormitory_inspections` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `dormitory_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `inspection_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `inspection_result` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `dormitory_id` (`dormitory_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `dormitory_inspections_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`dormitory_id`) REFERENCES `dormitories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `dormitory_repair_statuses` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `dormitory_repair_request_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `status_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `dormitory_repair_request_id` (`dormitory_repair_request_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `dormitory_repair_statuses_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`dormitory_repair_request_id`) REFERENCES `dormitory_repair_requests` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
